_doc: Mission Gorge Rd's raised median (Lake Murray piece C): the island's faces per station off the USGS 2024 lidar (mg_median_faces_g10.py, its docstring is the method). Piece frame: metres off piece C's line, + = left of J3 -> J4 travel = north-west. left_m / right_m = the two faces, width_m = left - right, middle_m = their mean; *_unc_m = half the interval between the neighbouring points the face lies between (point spacing); steps = top - road at each face; top_over_road_m = the top's median minus the mean of the two road lines at the faces. declared = the plan before ledger 0099 item 1b (mg_median_correction.json rows[0]); pc_fit = the rows the PC set; photo_raw = faces_md.py's station (before +0.30 / +0.49); photo_gaps = gaps_md.py's terracotta strip (salmon_middle_m turned into this frame).

frame.projection: shrub_heights.Track.to_local: pyproj EPSG 6340 -> 4326 ('Inverse of UTM zone 11N + NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)', stated accuracy 2.0 m), then the WGS84 metres-per-degree series at the origin

rings_side_a_left.what: MD11 / MD13 / MD13b rings: side A (the first half of polygon_xz) at median_off_m + w / 2, side B at - w / 2, in this frame (noses left out)

reference_stretches.what: faces_md.py's REF stretches (s 930-985, 1215-1260), where the PC took the island to fill its declared band and read the photo's bias there (width 0.30 m short, middle 0.49 m right): the lidar against the declared band and against the photo's own raw readings, station by station

md13_s252_300.what: MD13 just past the J3 range (2.2-2.5 m declared; the terracotta doc's registration slide put this piece of MD13 at 0.00 m)

road_at_line_minus_y3dep_m.what: the lidar road (set A within 0.5 m of the line) minus the plan's y_3dep, engine y

read.what: the J3 end as the lidar shows it (s of the first / last island station of each raised run, and of each run of 'none' stations): an end lies between its last island station and the next 'none' one

photo_raw.what: faces_md.py's medians before fix_mg_median.py added +0.3 m width and +0.49 m to the middle
faces_md.py's medians before fix_mg_median.py added +0.3 m width and +0.49 m to the middle

class_2_on_the_top.what: class-2 returns between the faces at island stations read off all returns: D24's ground class mostly leaves a narrow raised top out, so class 2 alone shows a hole there, not a plateau
